functions-consumption-linux-retirement.title: Linux Consumption hosting retires on 30 September 2028
functions-consumption-linux-retirement.body: This app uses the Consumption plan. Hosting function apps on Linux in a Consumption plan retires on 30 September 2028 and the plan gets no new features. Plan the move to the Flex Consumption plan, which is Linux-only, scales faster, and bills configured instance memory.

citation.quote: The option to host function apps on Linux in a Consumption plan is retiring on 30 September 2028.
